city_scope_filter.boundary_licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use.
city_scope_filter.boundary_scope: New York City borough boundaries, water areas excluded, current version 26a.
city_scope_filter.method: Retains current mapped transport stop/station anchors only when their source point or Overpass center proxy falls inside the official city boundary. Atlas bounds are used as a retrieval prefilter; the official boundary controls published city scope.

metadata.method: Current OSM public-transport stop and station anchors for New York City. The frontend uses these as mapped context for access-proxy guide geometry; they are not official service frequency, reliability, journey-time, or selected-year evidence.
caveats: Current mapped transport anchors may post-date selected timeline years.
OSM mapped visibility, stop names, and modal tags may be incomplete or stale.
No GTFS service frequency, timetable, journey time, accessibility compliance, reliability, or capacity is inferred.
metadata.thinning_method: Deterministic citywide grid-and-rank thinning keeps source-backed transport anchors distributed across the whole city while avoiding chaotic frontend density; selected anchors remain real OSM source objects.
